sources.entry: SpechtLite - Rule-based proxy app for macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/shadowsocks) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
SpechtLite - Rule-based proxy app for macOS.

summary.one_liner: SpechtLite is a rule-based proxy app for macOS, now archived, per its README.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only states that SpechtLite is archived because NEKit is deprecated. It does not describe features, setup, or usage. The awesome-mac and open-source-mac-os-apps listings describe it as a rule-based proxy app for macOS, filed under proxy and VPN tools. No further capabilities are documented in the material provided.
use_cases: route macOS traffic through proxy rules (historical)
reference for archived macOS proxy projects
stack: NEKit (named in README as deprecated dependency)
notable: Archived repository; README says it is no longer maintained because NEKit is deprecated
Listed as a rule-based proxy app for macOS in awesome-mac and open-source-mac-os-apps
caveats: Archived, so no further development is expected
Depends on NEKit, which the README says is deprecated
README gives no install or usage instructions
